name: Collateral Valuation 7
definition: Provides the specification of the valuation of a collateral, based on the sector and the asset classification.

PoolStatus.name: Pool Status
PoolStatus.definition: Specifies whether the collateral is a pool collateral or not.

Type.name: Type
Type.definition: Identifies the asset class pledged as collateral, expressed as an ISO 10962 Classification of Financial Instrument (CFI).

Sector.name: Sector
Sector.definition: Provides the institutional sector, such as central government, central bank, etc. of the issuer of collateral.

NominalAmount.name: Nominal Amount
NominalAmount.definition: Nominal amount of money of the security pledged as collateral, when the collateral cannot be identified through an individual or basket ISIN.
